forces.title: Rising EV Adoption Reduces PGM Demand in Auto Catalysts
forces.description: Increased adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), driven by strong sales, is a structural headwind for Platinum Group Metals (PGMs). As EVs replace internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles, the demand for PGMs, which are primarily used in auto catalysts to control emissions in ICE vehicles, is expected to decrease. This shift is a direct consequence of the automotive industry's transition towards electrification.

forces.title: Robust Manufacturing Output Fuels Industrial PGM Demand
forces.description: Robust growth in India's high-frequency macro indicators, including the Index of Industrial Production (IIP), signifies expanding manufacturing activity. This translates directly into higher industrial output, which in turn boosts the demand for Platinum Group Metals (PGMs). PGMs are crucial inputs for various industrial applications, such as auto catalysts (for manufacturing equipment and vehicles), chemical production, and hydrogen fuel cells, making their demand sensitive to the overall health of the manufacturing sector.

viewpoints.title: EV Penetration Creates Structural Headwind for Platinum Group Metals Demand
viewpoints.description: The increasing penetration of Electric Vehicles (EVs) is identified as a significant structural headwind for Platinum Group Metals (PGMs). This is because EVs directly displace Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) vehicles, and ICE auto catalysts represent the primary industrial demand for PGMs like platinum and palladium, crucial for emissions control. As EV adoption rapidly grows globally, the long-term demand for these essential PGM components in catalytic converters will likely experience a substantial decline, negatively impacting the overall PGM market and necessitating strategic adjustments for producers.

demand_drivers.description: PGMs are primarily driven by industrial demand for auto catalysts, hydrogen fuel cells, and chemicals, integrating them into broader manufacturing and energy transition sectors.

market_sizing.methodology: The precious metals market, a segment of the broader metals and mining industry, explicitly includes platinum, palladium, and rhodium alongside gold, silver, and diamonds. While no specific numerical market sizing for Platinum Group Metals (PGMs) is provided, their inclusion within this segment highlights their role as industrial metals in the overall market. The taxonomy also defines PGMs as having purely industrial demand for auto catalysts, hydrogen fuel cells, and chemicals.
